requirements.label: Eligible diploma subjects
requirements.details: A diploma must be in one of these areas: accounts, business administration, clearing and freight forwarding, computer science, cooperative management, customs and tax management, law, logistics and supply chain, tax management or teacher education with business or science subjects.

source.title: TCU 2026/27 · diploma or equivalent qualifications · PDF p. 217

requirements.label: Minimum grade on the qualifying diploma or equivalent award
requirements.details: For the listed diploma or equivalent-award route, the programme requires a B average or a minimum GPA of 3.0.

source.title: TCU 2026/27 · diploma or equivalent qualifications · PDF p. 217

requirements.label: National eligibility for diploma or equivalent applicants
requirements.details: The national baseline requires four O-level grades of D or above, an NVA Level III award with fewer than four passes, or a foreign equivalent assessed by NECTA or NACTVET. For NTA Level 6 the minimum GPA is 3.0. The general alternatives are an FTC with a C average (A=5, B=4, C=3, D=2), a B average for teacher education or health awards, distinction on an unclassified award, or upper second class for a classified non-NTA diploma. Each programme specifies which awards and subjects it accepts.

source.title: TCU 2026/27 · diploma or equivalent qualifications · PDF p. 13

requirements.label: Alternative · Open University of Tanzania foundation route
requirements.details: The programme accepts the OUT foundation award. The national minimum is a 3.0 GPA across six core subjects with C or better in three subjects from the relevant arts, science or business cluster. In addition, present 1.5 ACSEE points in two subjects, a recognised ordinary diploma at GPA 2.0, or NTA Level 5 / Professional Technician Level II.

source.title: TCU 2026/27 · diploma or equivalent qualifications · PDF p. 13, 217

requirements.label: Recognition of overseas qualifications
requirements.details: For a foreign national with an overseas university award, the receiving university obtains TCU recognition. A Tanzanian applicant with an overseas qualification obtains NECTA/NACTVET equivalence, an index number and an AVN. Where a foreign university award is used, the Tanzanian applicant obtains and submits TCU recognition.

requirements.label: National eligibility for diploma or equivalent applicants
requirements.details: The national baseline requires four O-level grades of D or above, an NVA Level III award with fewer than four passes, or a foreign equivalent assessed by NECTA or NACTVET. For NTA Level 6 the minimum GPA is 3.0. The general alternatives are an FTC with a C average (A=5, B=4, C=3, D=2), a B average for teacher education or health awards, distinction on an unclassified award, or upper second class for a classified non-NTA diploma. Each programme specifies which awards and subjects it accepts.

requirements.label: Alternative · Open University of Tanzania foundation route
requirements.details: The programme accepts the OUT foundation award. The national minimum is a 3.0 GPA across six core subjects with C or better in three subjects from the relevant arts, science or business cluster. In addition, present 1.5 ACSEE points in two subjects, a recognised ordinary diploma at GPA 2.0, or NTA Level 5 / Professional Technician Level II.
